action_file_enable_sync.description: If true, syncs log files after each write (enables durability at cost of performance)

custom_default_template.description: Optional custom default template format string (e.g., '%timegenerated% %HOSTNAME% %syslogtag%%msg%\n')

discard_local6.description: If true, discard all messages from the local6 facility (useful to silence noisy devices)

dynamic_host_logs.description: If true, create per-host log files using the DynHostFile template

input_modules.description: List of input modules to load; each must be an object with 'name' (module) and 'purpose' (human-readable description)

inputs.description: List of input definitions; each item must have 'type' (imuxsock/imudp/imtcp/imrelp), and port/path/address as appropriate

main_queue_size.description: Maximum number of messages in the main queue before blocking or dropping

remote_forwards.description: List of upstream syslog servers to forward to; each must have 'host', 'port', and 'protocol' (udp/tcp/relp)

rulesets.description: List of custom rulesets; each must have 'name', 'description', and 'rules' (list of selector/property filter rules)

use_rfc3339_timestamps.description: If true, use RFC3339 (ISO 8601) timestamps in file logs

work_threads.description: Number of worker threads to process messages (0–16 recommended)
